description: Machine-readable registry of the kēpàn-outliner evaluation datasets built on branch eval-datasets (plan docs/plans/2026-09-22-eval-datasets.md, Tasks 1-9) and the single source of truth for the dev / validation / test / reserve split spans (plan Global Constraint 5). Human guide: data/EVAL-SETS.md. Each dataset's `file_metadata` and `counts` blocks are computed from the files, and `scoring_scope.served_juan_halves` from splits.texts.T1718.juan_halves, by `python3 scripts/eval_sets.py --write` (a wrapper over chinese_workflow.eval.registry, which also gives a scorer read access: split_of, dataset, served_juan_halves, in_scoring_scope) and checked by `--check` and tests/unit/test_gold_registry.py; every other field is hand-written. Eval-only files live under data/raw/ (gitignored): their blocks keep the last computed values and are re-checked whenever the files are present.

splits.convention: Spans are CBETA lineheads at release 2026R2 (composed {xml:id}_p{lb@n}), start inclusive, end exclusive; end null = to the end of the file. A line of a split text that no listed span holds is `unlisted` (reserve for both texts). Within one of these files, string order of lineheads is document order (tests/unit/test_kepan_cases.py::test_split_files_are_monotonic). Gold spans are different: locations.root_text.end and metadata.coverage_spans ends are inclusive.
splits.quoting_rule: Parser test cases and fixtures may quote only dev spans or texts outside T1718 / T1723 (e.g. T1721, T1724, T1735, T1736). No validation- or test-span text in any case or fixture. Reserve: do not look at it while developing.

datasets.title: Zhiyi's 法華文句 科判 as served by sdp.chibs.edu.tw, anchored in the commentary
datasets.anchors_note: Primary locator: locations.commentary.explained = a T34n1718 line, sdp's anchor rule = the line where the node's own text span starts (not the line of Zhiyi's announcing formula, which can come lines or pages later). locations.root_text = the T09n0262 span of the T0262 node that links to this node (borrowed, only where the link is corroborated by a shared heading).
datasets.licence: none published (R04 F32): eval-only — written only under data/raw/dila-sdp/gold/, never committed, never used as prompt or training material; only aggregate counts may appear in committed files (Global Constraint 1).
datasets.built_by: cd pipeline && .venv/bin/python -m chinese_workflow.eval.gold.sdp (inputs: data/raw/dila-sdp/ from scripts/fetch_dila_sdp.sh; data/raw/cbeta/T09n0262.xml, T34n1718.xml)

scoring_scope.rule: E01 scores a predicted node only if its key locator (its explained line in T34n1718) lies in a 卷-half sdp serves; a prediction elsewhere is out of scope, neither TP nor FP, because this gold has no node there. Split membership (split_of) applies on top. chinese_workflow.eval.registry.in_scoring_scope implements the test; served_juan_halves is computed (start inclusive, end exclusive); first_half_from_file_start: sdp's page for 卷一上 opens at T34n1718_p0001a01, the file's first line, so it also serves the preface before 卷一上's 卷 mulu (start null = the start of the file; the preface is reserve by split). The T0262 sdp gold has no such restriction: root-text scoring against it covers all of T0262 (data/EVAL-SETS.md, 'Using these sets' item 5).

experiments.role: answer key for explicit-structure recovery on T1718: develop on dev, tune on validation, report on test; reserve untouched

gaps: sdp serves 9 of T1718's 20 卷-halves (splits.texts.T1718.juan_halves); nodes in the other 11 have no explained line and carry flag unmapped (counts.by_split['no locator']). Dev: only 卷一上 T34n1718_p0001b18–p0009b07 is served, and the gold has no node whose explained line falls in 卷一下 (p0009b07–p0016b02). Validation (2a, 2b and 3a up to p0036a26) is fully served. Test lacks 卷五上's part T34n1718_p0060c14–p0063b11 (no node there). Most of the reserve is unserved.
27 tree nodes came back fetch_error from sdp's getTreeNode (Task 1): 1 subtree was recovered from the HTML; the 26 whose subtree is unknown carry flag truncated (counts.flags.truncated).

Headings are sdp's, with sdp's leading ordinal kept in heading_src (display_label repeats it); Task 3's automated check finds only a minority verbatim in Zhiyi's wording (dataset sdp-T1718-heading-check). Score structure and locators; do not treat heading_src as Zhiyi's words.

Nodes without root_text (counts.nodes − counts.with_root_text: uncorroborated or misnested link, or no T0262 link) keep flag unmapped because the schema's sūtra-mode rule requires it, so unmapped is not the same as 'no explained line' (counts.by_split shows flagged nodes that do have one).

Scoring scope (E01, keyed on commentary.explained): only the served 卷-halves — of dev only 卷一上 (T34n1718_p0001b18–p0009b07), and the test split without T34n1718_p0060c14–p0063b11; a prediction in an unserved region is neither TP nor FP (machine-readable: scoring_scope; data/EVAL-SETS.md, 'Using these sets' item 5).
